name: obsidian-vault-checkup
description: Marketplace for the obsidian-vault-checkup plugin — a phased, evidence-driven audit for Obsidian vaults.

plugins.name: obsidian-vault-checkup
plugins.description: Run a periodic, phased audit of an Obsidian vault: review what core absorbed since the last checkup, snapshot installed plugins, fix common config drift, triage each plugin against real in-vault usage evidence, surface relevant trending community plugins, and record every meaningful decision in a vault-resident audit log.
